groups.sentence: Responsible AI use can support and enhance students' learning in the course.
Instructors describe to students how generative AI use can enhance their learning.
AI is a valuable, powerful tool that supports and enhances student learning.
AI can help students understand concepts, summarize sources, practice, and improve their writing and coding.
AI can personalize and adapt learning to each student's needs.
AI saves time and raises efficiency and productivity by taking over routine tasks.
AI can enhance teaching, learning, research and operations across the institution.
AI can support instructors in course design, grading, content creation and teaching practice.
AI has benefits for learning when it is used responsibly, appropriately and thoughtfully.
AI can help students with disabilities, language barriers or special needs take part more fully and equitably.
AI can foster creativity and innovation.
AI can help students brainstorm and spark ideas at the start of work.
AI can speed up research, discovery and data analysis.
Generative AI is transformative and will change how people teach, learn and research.
AI can act as a tutor, giving students instant feedback, practice and round-the-clock support.
The university wants to explore and embrace AI rather than ignore it.
Everyone should leverage AI to personalize learning and advance learning and creativity.
Generative AI brings both benefits and challenges.
